smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Plan2Render
shortDescription: Turns floor plans and sketches into photoreal renderings. Discovery is $15.
longDescription: Plan2Render takes a floor plan, an elevation, a PDF, an image, or a sketch and returns a photorealistic rendering. One credit is one render. Free is one watermarked credit and no card is required. Discovery is $15 for 10 credits on one project. Project Pass is $49 for 75 credits. Professional is $129 a month for 250 credits. Studio is $329 a month for 750 credits. Credit packs are $15 for 10, $25 for 25, $60 for 75, and $120 for 200.
pricingNotes: Free is 1 watermarked credit. Discovery is $15 for 10 credits. Project Pass is $49 for 75 credits. Professional is $129 per month for 250 credits. Studio is $329 per month for 750 credits. Packs are $15, $25, $60, and $120.
bestFor: A floor plan or elevation that should become an interior or exterior render
A sketch or reference photo for a renovation concept
notIdealFor: A free unlimited editor for drawing the plan yourself
Virtual staging of a listing photo as the only job
strength: Plan2Render turns a floor plan, an elevation, or a sketch into a photorealistic rendering.
weakness: The free grant is one watermarked credit, and a monthly plan starts at $129.
